notes.title: Playtest is LIVE
notes.content:
We are finally at a point where we would like to test the game and get valuable feedback to act upon and we are so happy that you would like to help us out. Please consider that the game is in beta, there will of course be bugs both small and large but we hope to catch as many of them as possible during this test.

There are, at the moment of writing, 220 out of the limited 300 test seats taken so first come first served.

All features that we have planned for the initial release are more or less in. The main thing except fixing bugs that we have on our to-do is to finalize all the games UI, there’s a lot of it,  and also to do a polish pass on everything.

There are recurring tournaments during the test and they will be live at times that suit their regions the best. Don’t forget to sign up to the tournaments in order to secure your place, this can be done 1 day in advance.

Tournament Schedule
EU
Prime Arena tournament 6 PM CEST
Prime Championship 8 PM CEST
Prime Single elimination bracket 10 PM CEST

US
Prime Arena tournament 6 PM EDT
Prime Championship 8 PM EDT
Prime Single elimination bracket 10 PM EDT

SA
Prime Arena tournament 6 PM BRT
Prime Championship 8 PM BRT
Prime Single elimination bracket 10 PM BRT

ASIA
Prime Arena tournament 6 PM CST
Prime Championship 8 PM CST
Prime Single elimination bracket 10 PM CST

What to do in the game
Some of the tournaments will reward the winner with an epic body armor (named Prime). Other tournaments will be fame and glory only.

In order to unlock more customization items you will need to rank up. XP is given every time you play an online match, ranked or tournament doesn't matter. You will also accumulate XP by playing the single player campaign. Winning that campaign will unlock exclusive items.

You can invite Steam friends if you want to challenge them as long as they have the game installed and couch play will enable you to play local games against a friend.

How can I report issues that I come across?
You can either report them to the discussion thread associated with this playtest.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1616330/discussions/

Or you can send an e-mail to dev@hellothere.se

You can also reach out to us at our discord, https://discord.gg/cpCQaZJ

The game has a built-in replay feature that saves all matches in a format so that we can step through them frame by frame for debugging purposes. If you, during a match, find something that looks odd, maybe a kick that didn’t register a hit or a score that wasn’t awarded properly please send us the replay file to dev@hellothere.se , it will help us tremendously with finding the bug as we can recreate the match on our end.

The replay files can be found here:
C:|Users|[username]|AppData|LocalLow|Hello There Games|Taekwondo Grand Prix|Replays


Known issues present in the Playtest

The belt colors will not update according to your level, they kind of show team colors at the moment.
Some UI elements don’t support gamepads, use your mouse and keyboard if you get stuck.
Tournament info doesn't update immediately, be patient when you queue up for games. As long as you have joined a match and clicked ready you are good to go.
Overall, the UI is not near complete but it is functional.
 

We hope that you will be enjoying the play test and that you want to share your thoughts and feedback with us.

The test will run for a while or until we feel that we have received enough feedback and bug reports to move forward onto the polishing phase.

We hope to see you in the arena!

notes.title: Taekwondo Grand Prix Development News
notes.content:
Character customization
Welcome back to another post about the development of the Taekwondo Grand Prix. This time around we will focus on a feature that has been at the top of requested features by both players and ourselves. The ability to customize the look of your fighter beyond the ready-made roster used in the previous version of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695256/aa88b3394daa2c322b78cddaca7d45d6ac344ef2.png

At launch, there will be four archetypes of people to choose from, both female and male. You will be able to adjust skin tone, eye colour, hairstyle. The style of the protective gear can be customized by skins and the same goes for the Dobok. Skins will be unlocked by playing the game or winning tournaments. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695256/072a490f9f3969705f8fca6159c67c4bddb30761.png

Another customizable area for you to get creative with is the player portrait, which is the image that is shown before entering a match and at the result screen. Elements to showcase in the portrait will also be unlocked or given as prizes in tournaments.

Please keep in mind that the first release will contain a limited set of assets for you to use when customizing. The goal for us is to have all systems in place and then be able to expand upon based on feedback from the community. So when available, try it out and help us explore further creative options to make the player avatar more unique. Stay tuned for the next dev log.

notes.title: At last some news of Taekwondo Grand Prix
notes.content:
What’s up with the Taekwondo Grand Prix?

The fall of 2020 we released a beta patch for the game. This was mainly a fix to get the multiplayer functionality back on its feet and to benchmark our new hosting provider. In order to test this we invited a couple of hundred players in hope that there would be some valuable feedback based on their experience. The result we got back was somewhat expected but at the same time disheartening. The overall experience was that the game lagged making it hard to throw kicks and anticipate moves by the opponent. Aside from that there were also some really nice ideas suggested that might become future gameplay features. But the lagging part could not be ignored as we strive to make this a fun online multiplayer game.

Is there any active development?

Fast forward to the present day, today we are happy to share with you what's to come of this game. We will also follow up with more posts the closer we get to release. So without further ado;


 Tournaments are coming to TKD. There will be daily, weekly tournaments rolling that the users can subscribe to. There will also be the possibility for users to create their own tournaments to host for friends or for the community.
 Character customization is coming to TKD making it possible to look as awesome as you like while entering the arena.
 Performance tuning, yeah it’s hard to believe but this game lives on a legacy reaching all the way back to 2013. Every internal system and visual assets is being ported to the latest Unity3D giving a more robust environment for our developers to work in but at the same time a more performant game for you to enjoy.


This major update of the game will be available for free to all owners, so don’t worry that it will be branded as Taekwondo Grand Prix 2. We know this isn’t much details at the moment but we wanted to share the news with you guys with a final remark, hang in there - great things are yet to come.

notes.title: PATCH 1.9.5 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/d3caab44c93450bf41f9b0705dc849a9a9dafdb0.png

GAME INTRODUCTION
The introduction to the game was, to be fair, something awkward and weird and kind of inherited from the mobile days of the game. We did something about that. About time, huh. 

SCORE BALANCING & RESULT SCREEN MMR 
First. The reward for winning a match and the penalty for losing one wasn’t quite balanced in the way we wanted it to be. So we rebalanced it, slightly. 
Second. Winning or losing - your reward or penalty in the score is now more visible and readable. Check it out in your result screen next time you finish a match.

MATCHMAKING 1: PRACTICE MODE
If you loved having nothing to do in the game while matchmaking - this is a sad update for you. Don’t worry, we’ll rip that bandaid off together, okay? Ready? Steady? Kapaow! Queueing up for a match now offers active practice mode. 

MATCHMAKING 2: NEW ARENA
One could argue that the use of “NEW” is a bit exaggerated here. We simply dimmed the lights in the Dojang arena. But hey, this is in the world of games and far bigger games have gotten away with far lesser cosmetic changes and called it an E X P A N S I O N. So, here we are. A new arena. Awesome!

ANIMATIONS 1: K.O. CELEBRATION
As if winning by K.O. didn’t feel awesome enough for you - and embarrassing enough for the losing part - we just added celebrating animations to the winner. Then again, if you’re a good sport about losing, you’ll enjoy the new content as well. Because that’s who we are. A bunch of good losers. Yeah.

ANIMATIONS 2: IMPACT
Hitting someone with a kick should feel awesome. Rewarding. Juicy. Intense. Moist. Flashy. Cool. We added some more impact animations on successful kicks. 

FONT SUPPORT
Letters are important. So are special characters and symbols and most of all - your names. We love your names. Our font did not reflect this love. Now it does. 

BONUS: CLOTH
Apparently, our Art Director spent some time exploring some kind of cloth animation for the leaderboard. That’s on the menu screen. Apparently, that was “totally necessary”. And apparently, it only took a “reasonable amount of time” to implement it. So, apparently, it’s in the game now. Leaderboard cloth. It’s a thing. 

PS. Our Art Director’s name in the game is Filip. Extra kudos for beating him.

notes.title: UPDATES IN MAY!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/6ed4ae5677097d67a31690923de0f5b12fb00b1a.png

Yes! Grand stuff is coming your way and we are really excited to take the Taekwondo Grand Prix to the next level. Here’s what to expect!


KNOCK OUT
It’s never really over until it’s really over! This powerful move can turn an entire match around (and finish it) and is the perfect way to punish aggressive players not minding their stamina. 


KICKS
Looking for kicks? We got them. All kinds of kicks for you here. High kicks. Low kicks. TURNING kicks! Most importantly, we’ve got some brand new kicks for you. 7 of them, actually. Kicks, that is. Anything else, look somewhere else but if it's kicks that you’re looking for - we got kicks.


STAMINA SYSTEM OVERHAUL
We’re very happy about our “stamina-instead-of-health-bar”, and have of course explored it further. Some kicks will drain stamina from your opponent, the instant or over-time cost for a move is revamped so yeah, better get that cardio going.


GLOBAL RANKING
In the name of international solidarity and to underline the fact that we are all the same, sharing our lives on this planet together - rankings are now global. Peace!


CONTROLS (+ INPUT BUFFERING)
Controls are almost entirely remapped. Kicks are not where they used to be and a bunch of new, excellent moves, have been put in there. We also solved a bunch of technical issues with the previous version.


CONTROLS (OVERVIEW)
Who thought martial arts could be so complicated? Well, with new moves, remapped controls and all that new and good stuff in the game - we had to update the pause menu overview. It’s juicy now. And informative.


BADGES & MMR
Ever felt confused regarding how the ranking system and badges work? You might find comfort in the fact that so did we. Jokes aside, it wasn’t as clear as we wished it to be, so we made it more transparent, created new badges and added a progress bar. 


SEASONAL COMPETITIONS (+WIPING CURRENT RANKS)
Winter is coming. Spring as well. And summer and… Ehm. Wait. SEASONS are coming! And they bring awards for winners. We’re resetting all current ranks and hope for everyone to feel as excited as we are. Good luck!


ROADMAP
Curious and want to stay up to date with what's happening and where TKD Grand Prix is heading? Check out our roadmap right here:

Taekwondo Grand Prix - Roadmap

notes.title: NEW PATCH: 1.8.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/5c6531a2a9b046cc0ae596b1206e9ae9585f77b6.jpg


GLOBAL STEAM LEADERBOARDS
Ever heard of the phrase “dance like no one’s watching”? Definitely not compatible with fighting. What’s the point of being awesome and winning with no bragging rights? 
Visit the Global Steam Leaderboards in-game or by this link on Steam:
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/462590/leaderboards/3109617

NEW EFFECTS
What’s better than kicking your friend in the face? Kicking your friend in the face while the whole screen rumbles and flashes to praise your unmatched skill!

NEW FACES
You’re bad at remembering faces? Are you that person who exits a room with a bunch of people and introduces yourself to someone you just talked to inside, 30 seconds ago? You’re gonna hate this one. For all others who believe that more is merrier and that diversity is a kind of a nice thing - this is for you.

TYLER IS IN
Speaking of faces, Tyler is in! Who’s Tyler, you ask? Oh, just the guy who won the eSport premiere of Taekwondo at the Grand Prix-event in Manchester! If you listen carefully, you can still hear the echo of the crowd, cheering for Tyler throughout eternity.

IN-GAME RESOLUTION FIXES
That pop-up you got when booting up the game? It’s gone. Resolution is now adjusted inside the game.

notes.title: NEW PATCH: 1.8.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/772d4f52491a0650b9910ec960749ab9c93e243e.jpg

TRADING CARDS ARE IN
Did you miss them? Of course you did! So did we! And like strike of magic - here they are! Enjoy!

ENDLESS MODE ACTUALLY GETS HARDER NOW
Sorry if you thought you were THAT awesome or that the game was just STUPID simple. Now, the “Endless AI” mode should work as intended. Up for the challenge?

THAT STUCK-IN-LOADING-BUG
It was more embarrassing for us than it was insulting to you, we hope. But hey, we fixed that and let’s not mention it when we meet with the family at xmas and everyone start telling awkward stories about each other? Pretty please?

FORFEITING A GAME
The scoring has been working properly all the way, we just cleared things up for you when it happens in the future. (Tip: Don’t forfeit games. It’s annoying for your opponent and it’s bad for your scoring!)

RENAMED MENU OPTIONS
Let’s face it, our options in the menu were suboptimal at best, a bit confusing at worst. So we cleared them up for you.  
 
NO MORE SILENCE I: AMBIENCE
It was cool at first, right? The whole mysterious no-music-during-the-fights-thing? Nah, neither thought we. Now there’s a sweet ambience-y tune playing, to really massage your ears while kicking your friends in the face. Yum.

NO MORE SILENCE II: TAB OUT
If you like to tab out while waiting in queue to fight - no worries. We’ve got your back. The game now let’s you know when a match is about to start. You just go ahead with watching memes, hoarding stuff from auction sites or scrolling your social medias like something will have changed since last time. 

PERSISTENT CROWD & LIGHTING
Did the crowd disappear after your first Manchester match? Don’t worry, it wasn’t you, it was totally us. Now they’ll stay. Forever. And ever… Oh, and to make them really feel present, we made sure the light stays on them.

OTHER
- Removed everything connected to the Manchester event
- Added pretty game box art for Twitch
